text: 我妈右手写快递单，笔一细就捏得疼。做个套在中性笔上的粗握套吧，成品长4公分，外径22毫米。
My OT wants to check the fit of a short right wrist splint before we add straps. Can you print an open palm-side shell, 135 mm long, for a 162 mm wrist circumference?
Could you make a chunky handle that snaps onto my soup spoon? 3.5 inches long, 32 mm outer diameter. Something that still feels steady when the bowl is full.
想打印个给右腕用的托板，手掌侧托住就行，手指要能敲键盘。腕围16.2厘米，整个护腕长14厘米。
Can you print a squishy sleeve for the gel pen I use to do crosswords? 42 mm long and 19 mm across the outside. My thumb gets sore on the skinny barrel.
我爸右手拿汤勺容易打滑，想在原来的不锈钢勺上加个粗把。握把长10公分，外径3.6公分，别一攥就转。
餐叉柄能打一个给左手用的吗？扁平的那面贴手掌，柄长85毫米，我吃饭时就不用把叉子攥那么紧。
lefty here. need a pen gripp with a spot for my thumb so i quit choking up on the pen. about 1 3/4 inches long pls
左手腕的支具能做开口式的吗？我单手不太好穿，量了下手腕一圈15公分，想让治疗师先看试戴效果。
need a fork handel for my left hand, the metal one turns when i try to stab peas. 9cm long, with a flat underneath so it sits still on the tray
left wrist support pls, the one i have digs in when i type. make the whole shell 5 inches long with the edge below the palm crease
左手写字用的笔握，想要拇指那里有个浅窝，别把手指卡死。套子长４５毫米就好。
Can you sketch a printable wrist brace shell that leaves my palm and thumb clear for wheelchair use? I don't have the fit measurements yet; my therapist will take them.
能印个能掰开扣到铅笔上的握把不？我老把泡棉套弄丢，桌上一滚就找不到了。
外婆想要原来那把饭勺，只是柄太细。能不能做个掰开就能套上去的把手，吃完我拆下来洗？
OT request: removable oval buildup for signing receipts with the right hand. Overall length 5.2 cm; wall thickness 2.4 mm. Keep the clip usable.
康复科试戴样件：腕手矫形器壳体全长155 mm，壁厚3.2 mm；掌指关节不覆盖，留绑带槽。
The big foam grip Dad likes measures 11 cm around. Can I get a printable handle for his teaspoon with that same outside circumference, but with a closed end so the spoon doesn't poke through?
Looking for a removable grip for the rounded table knife my daughter uses to spread jam. Easy to pull off for washing; I don't have a ruler here.
我媽原本的護腕卡到拇指根，想印一個拇指留空的腕托。腕圍還沒量，先讓治療師看看這種樣式行不行。
门诊作业治疗试用：为签字笔制作可拆卸的握笔套，长5.5 cm，壁厚2.8 mm，不加固定指槽。
Trial shell for a wrist-hand orthosis: wrist circumference 17.8 cm; shell wall thickness 3 mm. Leave both strap positions open for the fitting.
训练用圆头餐刀，给刀柄加一个能拔下来的加粗件。外径30 mm，插槽周围留4 mm壁厚，尾端做圆。
My son can hold a chunky crayon but not a regular pencil. Can you make a pencil grip that's 23mm in outside diameter with a flat bit so it doesn't roll off his desk?
I wrapped a strip of paper around the broadest part of my old writing grip: 7 cm around. Could you copy that girth in a new slip-on pen grip, without the sharp ridge the old one had?
我量了下旧饭勺的泡棉柄，软尺一圈9.5厘米。能照这个外周做个新柄吗？想让它搁在桌上也不乱滚。
I need a right wrist orthosis I can put on without feeding my hand through a tube. Wrist is 7¼ inches around; leave it open on the back with room for hook-and-loop.
软尺绕了一圈，我现在这个握笔器外周是6.5公分。新做的也这个围度行吗，表面不要有硌手的颗粒。
Kitchen trial for a client with a weak right grasp: build up a standard dinner fork. Keep the grip body 100 mm long, with a 3.5 mm wall at the socket.
右手用的腕夹板，治疗师在纸样上圈出来的那段长度是5.75英寸。做成背侧的，手心我还要拿东西。
想做左手无名指的指尖夹板，护住最末一节就好。治疗师给的长度是2.6公分，指甲别包住。
my hand gets tired halfway through yogurt. can you do a handle for the little spoon, about 1 1/8 in across the outside and not bumpy?
i dropped the foam thing off my click pen again. can you make a pen sleeve with a slit so i dont have to take the pen apart to put it on
幫我印一個套在叉子上的胖握柄，長三英吋。我右手抓久了會累，表面做成不磨手的就好。
給左手做個麥克筆的加粗握套，拿來在白板上寫字的。外徑四公分，側邊留個平面，擱桌上才不會滾。
Can I get a left index finger splint like a little cap, open at the nail? My therapist marked a span of 28 mm for the splint; I need the middle joint free.
小孩练自己吃饭用，做个短点的汤匙握把。成品长7.2厘米，外径28毫米，尾端加个圆耳朵方便我挂干。
Ring splint for my right ring finger, please. The inside opening should be 18.5 mm in diameter; I don't want a bulky band that catches on gloves.
右手用，想打个水彩笔笔握，手湿了也好捏。长度1又1/4英寸，纹路浅一点方便冲洗。
右手食指用的环形支具，上班戴手套时不想被勾住。内孔直径1.9厘米，边缘做圆。
Print a slip-on handle for one chopstick so I can practice picking up cubes with my left hand. I only want 65 mm of the stick covered by the grip.
For my left hand: triangular pen grip, three softened corners. Keep the sleeve to 1.5 in long and use a 3 mm wall.
笔握能不能做成那种胖胖的水滴形？我要套在自动铅笔上，最粗那截外径24mm，尾巴收细点别挡按键。
I keep dropping my fork on tile. I'd like a washable sleeve with a wall ⅛ inch thick and a slit I can open to move it between forks.
给中指做个指套式夹板，戴的地方拿纸条绕了一圈是5.7 cm。套子想用2毫米壁厚，指腹要露出来。
The therapist wants me to try a barrel grip on the pencil I use for sketching. Can the finished piece be 0.8 inches in outside diameter? No molded finger grooves—I rotate the pencil a lot.
My therapist asked for a trial sleeve for the tip joint of my middle finger. It should be 1 1/4 inches long, with a 2 millimeter wall and the pad of the fingertip exposed.
给长柄冰茶勺弄个握粑，别让金属边碰到虎口。只量了要套住的那一段，差不多9 cm长。
finger splnt for the left pinky, just the end joint, not all the way down. tape says 4.4 cm around at the spot where it'll sit.
Print me a short grip for a whiteboard marker; my right thumb slips when I teach. 35 millimeters end to end, and put the seam away from where the thumb rests.
Big round handle for my cereal spoon, please. Use a 4.25" grip length and put a little stop at the end nearest the bowl so my hand won't slide forward.
媽媽用左手拿點心叉。可以印一個外徑1.25英吋的套柄，讓她不用把手指彎那麼多嗎？
小拇指的护指能印不？想护着指尖那一节，打字还能弯下面的关节。我没量过，先不要做成跟整根手指一样长。
帮我弄个笔屋，呃是笔握。套圆珠笔的那种，壁厚大概3毫米，开口边别刮手。
Could you make the grip for my toddler's feeding spoon look less like a medical gadget? A smooth barrel with a 2.8-centimeter outside diameter would be good.
给小朋友做描字用的握笔套，最好一摸就知道食指放哪。长度3.8厘米，外径1.8厘米。
Is there a printable finger brace that leaves the fingertip free for turning book pages? It's for my index finger and my hand therapist wants to size it in person first.
Does a removable pen grip with a 2 mm thick wall sound doable? I want something I can slide on and off my fountain pen without scratching it.
想给木筷加个粗握柄，套子壁厚2.5毫米就行，外面做平整一点，擦起来不积饭粒。
左手拇指末节指托，长八分之七英寸。想在侧面留个小开口，好让治疗师帮我试戴时调整。
